author: sjm41
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
ERCC4 domain (IPR006166)

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly mms4 (FBgn0033549) = A1Z8C0

* **Description of issue**
This domain is found in fly mms4 (FBgn0033549) and its human orthologs (EME1 and EME2), which are the non-catalytic subunits of the MUS81-EME1 complex. (e.g. see https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q96AY2/entry description).

However, IPR006166 is currently annotated with '[nuclease activity (GO:0004518)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/GTerm?id=GO:0004518)' - I think this needs to be removed.
title: ERCC4 domain (IPR006166)
